title: Custom "Other" day periods now show up everywhere, not just Day view
summary: Custom time periods you add on an "Other" day (Field Trip, Bus Departure, etc. from the Day view's per-day picker) used to only appear on the Day view's time grid -- everywhere else that lists a day's classes (Home's Upcoming widget, the calendar previews on Home, the Calendar page's Week/Agenda/Hybrid/Month views) silently skipped them.
getClassesForDate now folds those custom periods in alongside real classes and the Lunch/Assembly synthetics, so they show up consistently anywhere a day's schedule is listed.
